findings.reason: DevSkim: ignore DS173237 -- public source SHA-256, not a credential. Reviewed directory-only false positive: 01770 permits the runtime group to write metadata, denies other users, and uses the sticky bit to protect root-owned entries. The rule incorrectly compares the numeric mode with file permissions. Descriptor-based ownership and no-follow checks remain enforced.

DevSkim: ignore DS173237 -- public source SHA-256, not a credential. Reviewed directory-only false positive: 0700 grants only the root owner directory traversal and write access. The rule incorrectly treats 0700 as more permissive than a regular-file mode. Removing owner execute would prevent required directory access.
